# Offline dependencies

- Vue 3.5.13, production global build, MIT.
- Source: https://unpkg.com/vue@3.5.13/dist/vue.global.prod.js
- License: VUE-LICENSE.txt, from https://github.com/vuejs/core/blob/v3.5.13/LICENSE
- CSS is authored locally in ../style.css (CoreSpace UI 1.0.0).
- No CDN scripts, remote fonts, Tailwind runtime or npm build are required to run the UI.
- Offline means disconnecting internet while the local Python server remains running.
